audit.whatIsWrong: Early phase said Roar of the Slayer shreds your magic resist.
audit.why: Riot's text for Roar of the Slayer says it reduces the Armor of the first enemy hit — there is no MR shred in Sion's kit.
audit.corrected: Early text and level-1 why now say armour shred, and note that the shockwave knocks minions back into you.

audit.whatIsWrong: Late spike stopped at 'full-tank zombie' without naming Glory in Death or why it changes the fight.
audit.why: Glory in Death reanimates Sion with rapid attacks that heal him and deal bonus damage based on target max health — killing him starts a second frontline.
audit.corrected: Late spike now names Glory in Death and the max-health damage, which is why raw MR is the wrong answer.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers claimed Twilight Shroud blanks / dodges the charged Decimating Smash.
audit.why: Twilight Shroud makes Akali unselectable and invisible; Decimating Smash is a ground-area swing that does not require selecting her, so it still lands if she stands in the arc. The shroud's real value is denying him the vision to aim.
audit.corrected: Rewrote every shroud-vs-Q line: the smoke breaks his aim, it does not blank the swing, so you still leave the arc. Added Soul Furnace's 15s cooldown and its 3-second delayed detonation.

edits.before: Sion pokes you with E (Roar of the Slayer) from range and shreds your MR while you're stuck farming in melee with only Q and no Shroud to disengage.
edits.after: Sion pokes you with E (Roar of the Slayer) from range and shreds your armour — not your MR — while you farm in melee with only Q and no Shroud.

edits.before: Once W (Twilight Shroud) is online you drop smoke on his telegraphed charged Q and walk out untargetable, neutralizing his only hard-CC kill threat.
edits.after: Twilight Shroud hides you, but Decimating Smash is an area swing — untargetable is not immune. Break his aim with smoke, then step out of the arc.

edits.before: Your R (Perfect Execution) lets you dash in and punish a whiffed charged Q, but his tank HP means you chunk and zone rather than kill outright.
edits.after: Perfect Execution punishes a whiffed charged Q — it is back in 10s at rank 1 — but his stacked HP means you chunk and zone rather than kill.

edits.before: Sion stacks HP and resists — your missing-health R execute can't push through a full-tank zombie, and his hard engage outvalues your assassination pattern.
edits.after: Sion stacks HP and resists — your missing-health R can't push through him, and killing him only starts Glory in Death, a second frontline that heals off its own attacks.

edits.before: Sidestep his charged Q (Decimating Smash) windup — it is fully telegraphed and is his only knockup/lockdown
edits.after: Leave the Decimating Smash arc — fully telegraphed, 10s at rank 1, and only a full charge knocks up

edits.before: Hold W (Twilight Shroud) for the moment he commits to a trade or winds up Q, then re-engage untargetable
edits.after: Hold Twilight Shroud to break his aim mid-charge — it hides you, it does not blank the swing, so leave the arc

edits.before: Poke you with E (Roar of the Slayer) and shred your MR under minion cover before your Shroud is up
edits.after: Poke with Roar of the Slayer, shredding your armour, and knock minions back into you before Shroud is up

edits.before: Sion owns the first three levels here — his E (Roar of the Slayer) pokes you from range and shreds your magic resist while you're stuck farming in melee with only Q (Five Point Strike) and no Shroud yet to reset a trade. You also soak minion aggro as a melee in a ranged-tank lane. Do NOT walk into a fully-charged Q (Decimating Smash); the knockup is his entire kill setup and it is completely telegraphed, so sidestep the windup. Farm at max Q range, accept the E poke, and don't burn E (Shuriken Flip) trying to commit — you can't kill a Sion this early, and even a clean trade just lets his sustain and his eventual zombie passive reset the math.
edits.after: Sion owns the first three levels here — his E (Roar of the Slayer) pokes you from range and shreds your armour, not your magic resist, while you're stuck farming in melee with only Q (Five Point Strike) and no Shroud yet to reset a trade. The shockwave also knocks minions back into you, so it hits through the wave. Do NOT stand in a fully-charged Q (Decimating Smash); the knockup is his entire kill setup and it is completely telegraphed, so leave the arc during the windup. Farm at max Q range, accept the E poke, and don't burn E (Shuriken Flip) trying to commit — you can't kill a Sion this early.

edits.before: Once W (Twilight Shroud) comes online around 4-5 the lane equalizes — drop smoke the instant he winds up his charged Q and you walk out untargetable, blanking his only real lockdown. Cross your Assassin's Mark ring to land an empowered auto if he steps up greedily to E-poke. At 6 your R (Perfect Execution) is your best window: dash in to punish a whiffed Decimating Smash for a real chunk. But be honest — he is a tank with a self-shield W, so you bully and zone him, you do not delete him through that much effective HP.
edits.after: Once W (Twilight Shroud) comes online around 4-5 the lane equalizes — smoke the instant he winds up his charged Q and he loses the vision to aim it, but the swing is an area hit, so still walk out of the arc rather than stand invisible in it. Cross your Assassin's Mark ring to land an empowered auto if he steps up to E-poke. At 6 your R (Perfect Execution) is your best window: dash in to punish a whiffed Decimating Smash, 10s at rank 1. But he is a tank with a self-shield that detonates 3s later, so you zone him, you do not delete him.

edits.before: You have only Q with no Shroud yet, so his ranged E poke and MR shred out-trade you while you eat minion aggro as the melee in lane.
edits.after: You have only Q with no Shroud yet, so his ranged E poke and armour shred out-trade you while you eat minion aggro as the melee in lane.

edits.before: W (Twilight Shroud) blanks his charged Q and lets you reset trades freely — but his HP keeps you from killing, so the level nets even.
edits.after: Twilight Shroud hides you mid-charge but never blanks the area swing — you reset trades, yet his HP keeps you from killing, so it nets even.

edits.before: He stacks HP and resists until your missing-health R can't execute him, and his hard engage plus zombie passive outvalue you — he reclaims the late game.
edits.after: He stacks HP and resists until your missing-health R can't execute, and killing him only starts Glory in Death — a healing second frontline that reclaims the late.

edits.before: Shroud his Q — Q-poke his immobile body. Akali wins the Decimating Smash cooldown windows.
edits.after: Smoke breaks his aim, not his Q — leave the arc. Akali wins the Decimating Smash windows.

edits.before: Shroud rewrites any trade he starts. Only take the trade when Sion's Decimating Smash is down.
edits.after: Smoke breaks his aim, not the swing. Trade when Decimating Smash is down, 10s at rank 1.

edits.before: - Sion Decimating Smash: matchup-defining — Charged = knockup. Shroud-dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Sion Decimating Smash, 10s at rank 1: a full charge knocks up; smoke hides you but never blanks the swing. - Soul Furnace, 15s: it detonates 3s later for max-HP magic. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.before: Charged = knockup. Shroud-dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Full charge = knockup, 10s at rank 1. Leave the arc; smoke only hides you.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Soul Furnace is 15s and detonates 3s later for max-HP magic.

notes: Two hard errors fixed: Roar of the Slayer shreds armour, not MR; and Twilight Shroud does not blank Decimating Smash — unselectable is not immune to a ground-area swing, the smoke only denies him the aim. Both layers repeated 'Shroud-dodge it'.
